	title = oe_v58_afr.13.title
	desc = oe_v58_afr.13.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event/backgrounds/interior/nobles/ashanti_nobles_interior.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { tag = ELR }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
		oe_v58_afr_era_window = yes
		current_year >= 1380
		current_year <= 1540
		oe_v58_afr_is_kanem_bornu = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_v58_afr_ev_13_seen value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v58_afr_ev_cd value = 1 days = 365 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_v58_afr.13.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_v58_afr_ev_13_a_tt
		add_gold = -65
		add_legitimacy = 8
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v58_afr_mod_ev_ngazargamu_bricks years = 20 mode = replace }
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 60
			modifier = { factor = 1.4 gold >= 90 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_v58_afr.13.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_v58_afr_ev_13_b_tt
		add_stability = 8
		add_prestige = 6
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.3 stability < 15 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_v58_afr.13.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_v58_afr_ev_13_c_tt
		add_gold = 85
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.4 gold < 60 }
		}
	}
}
